requirements.invariant: All logical command/query contracts are explicitly versioned; breaking major versions require an explicit migration and unsupported versions return explicit incompatibility.
Legacy reuse requires an explicit crosswalk, semantic ownership remains 021F, and ambiguous mappings are quarantined for adjudication.
Legacy migration is idempotent, resumable, content-digest verified, and produces a reconciliation report; identity/digest conflicts halt.
Export preserves change identity, version, evidence references, and event order while rejecting secret material and invalid ordering.
